⭐ About the creator of Tilo.Go

👋 Hi, I’m Hoàng Bình Minh. I’m 13 years old and currently learning German.

🎮 I started learning programming in Grade 4 because I loved games. From Scratch to Python, web development and now AI, I have always enjoyed turning my ideas into real products.

🎓 I have completed the Goethe A1 certificate and I am currently studying A2. While learning German, I had a thought:

“Why not use technology to create a tool that makes learning easier?”

💡 And that is how Tilo.Go was born.

💜 I originally built Tilo.Go to support my own learning. Then I realised that other beginners learning German might also benefit from a tool like this, so I decided to make it available for everyone to use for free.

🚀 I continue to learn programming and German every day. I am currently working through A2, aiming for B1, and I plan to keep developing Tilo.Go alongside my learning journey.

✨ What makes Tilo.Go different
